address: InterContinental Jeddah, Hussein Basalamah, Jeddah, 23212, Saudi Arabia
bio: The name says it all – take your pick of an array of fish and shellfish, locally sourced from the nearby Red Sea, all displayed on ice. While your fish is being prepared – fried or grilled as you like – start with a refreshing salad from the colourful salad bar or have the creamy fish soup. Finish off with a cracking crème brûlée while enjoying the views of the Jeddah Corniche and the magnificent King Fahd’s Fountain.
